rule: Production execution is enabled only for an exact authorization key that has passed contract, availability and execution-quality certification. Broker brand alone is never sufficient.
quality_first_routing: If multiple authorized execution routes exist, rank by expected net execution quality after spreads, commission, funding, slippage, fill probability, latency, margin efficiency and rejection risk. Introducing-broker remuneration is never allowed to promote an inferior route.
unsupported_environment_policy: FAIL_CLOSED_NO_LIVE_TRAILARIS_EXECUTION; subscriber must use a Trailaris-authorized environment.
governance: This contract does not force Trailaris through one jurisdiction or broker. Authorization is granular to the exact legal entity/server/account/symbol/strategy execution environment.
